stories.title: Video shows tornado forming over village in France
stories.summary: A tornado filmed near Pomas in southern France damages about 300 homes and injures 39 people as rescue teams search affected villages.

stories.title: Watch: Viking Age anchor recreated with hammer and bellows in Denmark
stories.summary: Blacksmiths recreate a Viking Age anchor with bloomery iron and historic techniques at Aggersborg in northern Denmark.

stories.title: UN and Red Cross warn 'risks have intensified,' urge regulation of killer robots
stories.summary: Lethal autonomous weapon systems are generally understood as weapon systems that select targets and apply force without human intervention.

stories.title: US terror list removal 'shakes off dark stain' from Syria, al-Sharaa says
stories.summary: Washington rescinded a designation in place since 1979, lifting severe economic restrictions and opening the door to private investment, as the US State Department also removed the terror designation from HTS, the group al-Sharaa led to topple Assad.

stories.title: One million Afghan children suffering 'life-threatening' malnutrition, UNICEF says
stories.summary: Afghanistan has endured repeated periods of widespread hunger in recent decades as it has struggled through civil war and other crises.

stories.title: Trump considering renaming Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' as trade war with Canada escalates
stories.summary: The rhetoric between the two countries is escalating, with Trump telling Canadian leaders on Monday to “fall in line” or face consequences “far WORSE” than existing tariffs.

stories.title: Qatar says officials working daily to revive US-Iran talks, urges Tehran to reopen Hormuz
stories.summary: Qatar says its officials are speaking to the parties daily to restart US-Iran negotiations, while urging Tehran to reopen and immediately restore freedom of navigation through the key energy route.

stories.title: Azerbaijan's biggest bank enters Uzbek market with Davr Bank acquisition
stories.summary: Azerbaijan's largest financial institution, the International Bank of Azerbaijan, is expanding its corporate banking operations by acquiring a 51% controlling stake in Uzbekistan's Davr Bank in a deal valued at $150 million (€128.5m).

stories.title: Mongolia positions itself as Asia's next data centre hub
stories.summary: During the COP17 conference in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia offered potential data centre investors tax relief, data security, cheap energy, land, and cold weather.

stories.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
stories.summary: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

stories.title: Next Atlantic tropical storm will be named Dolly but no connection to Parton's death
stories.summary: Storm systems are named by procedures set by the World Meteorological Organisation and the lists of names are reused every six years.
